summary: Official City of Buffalo and Erie County GIS sources were verified. The current Erie County ArcGIS parcel layer returned bounded full polygon geometry with native OBJECTID identifiers, including one exact WUP-point response and a separate two-feature retained sample. Runtime remains held pending serial reviewer qualification.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and native/local-language discovery query text, outcomes and actual result URLs are recorded in city-8207-buffalo.json.
